text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Light O-san!! Happy birthday to you!!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Your straightforward 
congratulations are the greatest gift of 
all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For someone who always charges straight 
ahead, I have prepared a fitting present 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That would be... a com-plete-ly flat 
globe!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, you were certainly tough to 
track down! Going in a straight line from 
one end of the world to the other!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, it might be a teeny bit tricky to 
use, but isn't that part of the fun?! 
Hah-hah-ha!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A straight globe, you say? That is—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Isn't this the best present ever?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I've always wondered. Why is the Earth 
round? A flat Earth would surely be 
wonderful too, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The globe I've longed for. I'll enjoy it. 
Like imagining running in a straight line 
from country to country, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, how delightfully straightforward! By 
all means, please allow me to join you!
